title: A letter that writes another patient's member ID or claim number, with a letter prefix or digits alone, with a dash, spaces or an invisible character, `_`, `.`, `/`, `:`, `#` or `(` next to a letter, after `ID:`, in brackets or as a claim placeholder's digits (`[CLAIM_7654321]`)
assertion: The one-patient screen is offered it, in the redacted letter too; a placeholder's word, or a redacted letter's own placeholder, never. Digits alone with `/` or `.` between them are not offered (a date's or an amount's writing; recorded in docs/adr/0054)
noFileReason: Letters are generated in memory by the property test; no file.
